---

## INCIDENT REPORT: STRRAT MALWARE INFECTION

**Date:** 2024-07-30  
**Analysis Method:** PCAP forensic analysis using tshark

### VICTIM HOST

**IPv4 Address:** 172.16.1.66  
**MAC Address:** 00:1e:64:ec:f3:08  
**Windows Hostname:** DESKTOP-SKBR25F  
**Logged-in User Account:** ccollier  
**Operating System:** Microsoft Windows 11 Pro, 64-bit  
**Endpoint Protection:** Windows Defender (not installed)

### MALWARE IDENTIFICATION

**Malware Family:** STRRAT  
**Version:** 1.6  
**Bot ID:** 1BE8292C  
**Attribution Type:** Signature-confirmed via beacon payload analysis

The malware identity was established through analysis of network beacon traffic containing cleartext STRRAT identifiers and system profile data.

### INDICATORS OF COMPROMISE

#### Command-and-Control Endpoints

| Endpoint | Port | Protocol | Purpose | Confidence |
|----------|------|----------|---------|-----------|
| 141.98.10.79 | 12132 | TCP | Primary C2 beacon | HIGH |
| 199.232.196.209 | 443 | HTTPS | Secondary C2/malware download | MEDIUM |
| 185.199.110.133 | 443 | HTTPS | Malware payload staging | MEDIUM |

#### Malicious Domains

- **wpad.wiresharkworkshop.online** - Proxy auto-discovery probe (8 failed DNS queries)

#### Reconnaissance/Geolocation Services

- **ip-api.com** (208.95.112.1:80) - Malware performing geolocation reconnaissance on 2024-07-30 at 06:40:18 UTC+4

#### Beacon Traffic Signature

The malware sends regular beacons every ~5 seconds to 141.98.10.79:12132 containing:
```
ping|STRRAT|1BE8292C|DESKTOP-SKBR25F|ccollier|Microsoft Windows 11 Pro|64-bit|Windows Defender||1.6|US:United States|Not Installed|[UPTIME]
```

Data exfiltration to secondary C2 servers:
- 199.232.196.209:443 (8.9 MB total)
- 185.199.110.133:443 (833 KB total)

#### Artifact Characteristics

- **Beaconing Pattern:** Regular 5-second intervals with system profiling payload
- **Encryption:** TLS 1.3 for data channels
- **Data Leak Indicators:** Geolocation API queries (malware reconnaissance for anti-forensics/evasion)
- **Proxy Enumeration:** Multiple WPAD queries indicating proxy configuration discovery

### THREAT ASSESSMENT

The infected workstation is actively beaconing to an external command-and-control server, indicating a live, operational compromise. The malware is exfiltrating system information and has downloaded/staged payloads from secondary infrastructure. The absence of Windows Defender provides no runtime protection.
